scope: Archival reference photographs for homepage display. The Compare viewer uses the separate SPHEREx archive cutouts. The downloaded JPEG bytes are preserved. The cards crop images for layout.

barnards-star.label: ESO · DSS2
barnards-star.note: Three colored points near the center mark Barnard’s Star in different exposures.
barnards-star.alt: Wide star field around Barnard’s Star, shown in three colours near the center for three survey exposures.
barnards-star.credit: ESO/Digitized Sky Survey 2 Acknowledgement: Davide De Martin, E — Red Dots
barnards-star.licence: CC BY 4.0 for ESO’s published image
barnards-star.framing: Centered crop of the published optical composite.

epsilon-indi-b.label: ESO · 2MASS near-infrared panel
epsilon-indi-b.note: Epsilon Indi B is circled on the left.
epsilon-indi-b.alt: Epsilon Indi B is circled at the left of the orange 2MASS Ks image. The bright star on the far right is Epsilon Indi A.
epsilon-indi-b.licence: CC BY 4.0 for ESO’s published image
epsilon-indi-b.framing: Homepage frames the lower 2MASS Ks panel of the published optical/near-infrared collage.

wise-0855.label: Webb · NIRCam
wise-0855.note: WISE 0855 is the orange source at the center.
wise-0855.alt: Near-infrared Webb view of WISE 0855-0714, the orange source near the center.
wise-0855.credit: NASA/ESA/CSA JWST NIRCam, Alves de Oliveira et al. and Melina Thévenot
wise-0855.framing: Centered crop of the published F200W/F444W colour composite from NIRCam observations.

rw-aurigae.label: Pan-STARRS1 · Optical colour
rw-aurigae.alt: Pan-STARRS1 optical field centered on RW Aurigae, with a bright central source and surrounding stars.
rw-aurigae.licence: Public PS1 survey data under MAST Data Use
rw-aurigae.framing: Colour composite of three optical survey stacks. The homepage crop excludes the blank edge of the skycell.

r-draconis.label: Pan-STARRS1 · Optical r band
r-draconis.alt: Monochrome Pan-STARRS1 optical field with R Draconis at the bright center.
r-draconis.licence: Public PS1 survey data under MAST Data Use
r-draconis.framing: Centered crop of a greyscale optical r-band survey stack.
